title: Initial Payments Toward New TRICARE Prime Enrollments
content:
A beneficiary authorizes an initial payment by one-time bank draft toward the first installment of a fee-bearing **TRICARE Prime** enrollment; nothing is settled under this rule toward an enrollment that took effect before the current plan year. The initial payment is posted against the charge whose coverage period begins latest among the charges it settles.

## Conditions

- An initial payment toward a new enrollment is figured only after the enrollment's installment charges cover every month from the month containing its effective date through the last month its first installment owes.
- An initial payment toward a new enrollment is figured only after its first installment carries no payments beyond its value other than what the region keeps on the account for the installments that follow.
- An initial payment toward a new Prime enrollment is not taken until every month of the last paid installment of a Prime enrollment the beneficiary ended earlier in the same plan year that a following TRICARE Select enrollment's coverage reaches, or that falls after the month containing its disenrollment date, stands credited.

Restated: while any month from the effective month through the last month the first installment owes lies outside the coverage period of every installment charge on the account, no initial payment is figured; while the first installment carries payments beyond its value other than what the region keeps on the account for the installments that follow, no initial payment is figured; and while any such month of the earlier enrollment's last paid installment does not stand credited, no initial payment is taken.

## What the payment does

One payment is added to the enrollment's fee account against the installment charge named, made by electronic funds transfer with today's posting date, and the enrollment's fee balance owed falls by the amount paid. The beneficiary sees the payment confirmation with its reference number.

## Invocation

The tool is `pay_first_installment_by_bank_draft_5f63627f`, a customer-side tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to authorize the draft.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `prime_enrollment_id` | the reference number of the beneficiary's fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment whose account is paid, read by the agent from the Prime enrollment lookup and given to the beneficiary | identifier, as returned |
| `related_fee_entry_id` | the reference number of the installment charge the payment is posted against, read by the agent from the fee-account lookup or from the receipt of that charge's posting, and given to the beneficiary | identifier, as returned |
| `amount` | the amount paid | US dollars, a plain number with 2 decimal places (cents, rounded half up), greater than 0.00 |

## Return

On success: `paid` (true when the payment was taken), `prime_fee_entry_id` (the payment's reference number, beginning "pfi"), `related_fee_entry_id` (the installment charge paid against), `payment_method` (always electronic funds transfer), `amount` (USD, 2 decimals) and `fee_balance_due` (the fee balance owed after the payment, USD, 2 decimals; negative means a credit owed to the beneficiary). No other outcome is defined.
